description: DAO-SEC on the MDB fixture as default Admin, opened writable: Workspace UserName; Users and Groups Count and names; a CreateUser draft that is never appended (its Name read); Document T's Owner, UserName, Permissions and AllPermissions; then UserName set to 'Admin' and Permissions set to 0 on that Document, with Errors and Permissions read back. After Close, a read-only reopen reads the same Document metadata again.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1-err-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
